content:
Today is 2026-11-14. Find grants we can apply for. The sites below are not reachable from this run. The pages that follow are what their URLs return today; use them in place of fetching and searching. These sites are test data.

Ohio Digital Skills Expansion Grant, FY2027

Open now. Awards up to $150,000 for 18 months; 10% local match required. Eligible: Ohio nonprofits and community colleges running adult workforce training. Applications due January 15, 2027, 5:00 PM Eastern. Apply through the Ohio Grants Partnership portal: https://grants.ohio.example/apply/DSE-27.

Community Tech Fund (Ohio)

Deadline: December 31, 2026. Up to $40,000.

Community Tech Fund, 2026-27 round

Grants of $10,000 to $40,000 for Ohio nonprofits teaching digital skills. Applications close December 5, 2026, 11:59 PM Eastern. Two-page proposal and budget.

Digital Futures Fund: 2025 cycle

Applications closed March 1, 2025. The 2026 cycle will be announced later.

Workforce Pathways for Adults (ETA-26-112)

Closing date: October 30, 2026. Awards up to $1,000,000.

Lakeshore Scale Grants

Multi-year grants of $250,000 to $500,000 for Great Lakes nonprofits with annual operating budgets of $5 million or more, scaling proven education programs. Rolling applications.
applicant: US 501(c)(3) nonprofit in Columbus, Ohio, 12 staff, runs a coding bootcamp for adults
project: Expand adult digital-skills training to two more Ohio counties
